stem:
Bhavna uses two natural indicators.
Turmeric paper stays yellow in lemon juice and turns red-brown in soap solution.
China rose extract turns dark pink in lemon juice and turns green in soap solution.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Lemon juice is basic because turmeric paper stayed yellow.
Soap solution is acidic because china rose extract changed colour.

teacher.key_rationale: With these natural indicators, yellow turmeric and dark pink china rose mark an acid; red-brown turmeric and green china rose mark a base. So lemon juice is acidic and soap solution is basic.
